description: This walk takes you along a lovely section of the Oxford Canal Walk from Banbury to Oxford. The route runs for just over 26 miles, passing along the flat canal towpath in a southerly direction. On the way you will pass the settlements of Kings Suttton, Kirtlington and Kidlington before coming into the famous university city. The route includes pretty villages, picturesque locks and fine views of the surrounding Oxfordshire countryside and hills. You can continue your canal walking around Banbury on the Banbury to Cropredy Canal Circular Walk.
